# Markdown versus HTML

> **这页管什么**：两者选一，不要混用。
>
> 来源：<https://developers.google.com/style/markdown> · CC BY 4.0 · 本文件是**规则摘要**，非原文全文。

## General

**Use either HTML or Markdown** — they're alternatives, not to be mixed. Parts of the style guide assume HTML, so some instructions won't apply to Markdown users.

## Comparative strengths

- **Markdown** is easier to write, and its source is easier for most humans to read.
- **HTML** is more expressive, especially for semantic tagging, and can produce effects difficult or impossible in Markdown.

## A Markdown limitation

HTML may be necessary for cases like the `code` element with special characters such as nonbreaking spaces.

## Choosing

Largely a matter of personal preference. **If an existing team or document template already has an established choice, defer to it.**
